correctness.rationale: Tensor-factor Laplacian eigenvector calculation yields a positive resolvent kernel for an edge dipole. The factor heat-kernel formula proves exact signs of every gradient difference, permitting a justified absolute transfer-row summation. The resulting two-term direction formula is attained by a row-sign input, independent of orientations. An AM--GM bound on each pair of factor rates proves a global maximum and characterizes equality, including the d=1 boundary; strict row comparisons identify minimal alphabet directions. Independent rational grounded-Laplacian calculations reproduce all 478 rows across 24 examples. Proof establishes arbitrary d and q_j; finite tests are not promoted to exhaustive certification.

value.rationale: Exact finite-dimensional operator norms for all Cartesian products of complete graphs, in every alphabet dimension and every positive axis weight, are natural stability invariants for electrical gradients. The sharp global conductance-optimization and its rigid equality classification predict how to tune a network and quantify anisotropy, and the q-ary Hamming family demonstrates exact logarithmic amplification. This is structural, nontrivial and not a routine recomputation of an existing known special case. No general graph claim or algorithmic improvement is asserted.
